The panel was changed in accordance with RRS 63.7(c)(2): Luke Scott and Manuel Huensch were replaced by Sandra Hatch and Niclas Kath.

Travemünder Woche 2026 Case Details Facts
Original hearing:
As of 20 JUL 2026 At 21:09
Wind 14-15 kn with puffs and a short choppy waves.
In the second race on the first beat to windward GER 3 was approaching the windward mark
Bevor the mark she bore away and did not round mark 1a and 1b. Facts
Reopened hearing:
After coming ashore on July 19th, the crew of ITA 2 spoke to GER 3 about an incident that happened on the water.
ITA 2 did not ask GER 3 about her bow number, sail number or name.
GER 3 had bow number 114 on July 19th.
ITA 2 filed a protest, and put in GER 20 as the protestee.
In the description of the incident, ITA 2 only mentions boat 107, which is the bow number of GER 20.
ITA 2 intended to protest GER 3.
conclusions: By not passing mark 1a and 1b on the required side, GER 3 failed to sail the course, and broke RRS 28.1.
The protest did not identify the correct protestee as required by RRS 60.3(a). Therefore the protest is invalid under RRS 60.4(1)(a).
decision: Original hearing decision: GER 3 is DSQ in race 2.
Reopened hearing decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
